thread:
Maya Patel: quick follow-up from last night's incident — summary: missing spans surfaced (service-auth exporter OOM), aggregator logic change + high-concurrency resulted in double-counting of traced spans, and our ETL consumer lagged ~30m while backlog drained. posting action items and owners here for tracking.

Kevin Zhou: thanks. can we get concrete owners + timelines? also any hotfixes required?

Maya Patel: yes. high-level plan: immediate hotfix for exporter stability, aggregator idempotency + unit tests, backfill/backpressure for ETL consumer, and dashboards/alerts to detect recurrence. assigning below.

Sophia Kim: I'll take exporter stability (heap bump + circuit-breaker). hotfix PR today, follow-up refactor in 2 weeks. PR draft: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4582. ETA hotfix: tomorrow EOD.

Kevin Zhou: I'll own aggregator dedupe & correctness. plan: add deterministic grouping key + sliding-window dedupe + stress test under synthetic load. I'll aim for a hotpatch for edge-case double-counting in 48h, full test coverage in next sprint. Github branch: kg/agg-dedupe-2026.

Jonas Rivera: I'll own ETL consumer recovery and backfill orchestration. immediate step: run controlled backfill to re-ingest missing spans and monitor offsets. Proposed command: `./scripts/run_backfill.sh --topic spans --from 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z --to now --parallel 6` (I'll tune parallelism). Will also add consumer metrics for processing lag and backpressure. ETA backfill plan: EOD today, run overnight.

Liam O'Connor: I'll update dashboards and alerts. Add metric span_loss_rate, distinct_count vs aggregated_count delta, and an anomaly alert if delta > 0.5% for 5m. Also add a recurring monthly query for 'aggregation variance' to catch slow regressions. ETA dashboard updates: tomorrow morning.

Maya Patel: extra notes: create Jira tickets for each action and link to postmortem: RN-2310 (exporter), RN-2311 (aggregator), RN-2312 (etl backfill), RN-2313 (dashboards/alerts). I'll file the RN tickets and link owners.

ops-bot: created RN-2310, RN-2311, RN-2312, RN-2313 and assigned to respective owners.

Kevin Zhou: quick technical note — root cause for aggregator double-counting came from concurrent map merge + unordered shard rollover. I'll add a deterministic merge reduce and a regression test that simulates shard rollover. Also adding a canary in prod that runs a small synthetic stream.

Sophia Kim: exporter OOM was triggered by a rare spike in trace size + missing memory cap in the new client lib. Hotfix will set max-queue-size and a soft reject path + metrics for rejected spans. Will add integration test to simulate large span payloads.

Jonas Rivera: re: backfill — we'll avoid reprocessing duplicates by leveraging the new dedupe key Kevin is adding. I'll coordinate order: wait for Kevin's hotpatch (48h) before major backfill run. Running small sample backfills first.

Liam O'Connor: also propose a lightweight monthly postmortem audit for observability regressions: look at last 6 weeks of incidents, aggregate by root cause categories (exporter, aggregator, ETL, infra) and trend counts. If a category appears >=3 times in 6 weeks, trigger a deeper reliability review.

Maya Patel: agree. we'll add that audit to the SRE calendar and assign a rotating owner. proposed recurring cadence: monthly review on first Tuesday.

Kevin Zhou: blockers? I need a test dataset that reproduces the double-counting edge case. Jonas, can you export a small window from the backlog?

Jonas Rivera: yes, I can export a 2-hour block that hit the issue. will drop in /mnt/shared/incident-dumps/1799234567/ by EOD.

Sophia Kim: will coordinate the hotfix release with deploy-bot — want a quick canary to 10% first.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for service-auth/exporter 2026.03.23-hotfix -> 10% traffic at 2026-03-23T02:30:00Z. Rollout policy: auto-promote on zero-error 15m.

Maya Patel: summary of immediate action items (short):
- Sophia: exporter hotfix (EOD tomorrow) -> RN-2310
- Kevin: aggregator dedupe hotspot fix (48h hotpatch, full in sprint) -> RN-2311
- Jonas: backfill plan + small sample run (EOD today) -> RN-2312
- Liam: dashboards & alerts (tomorrow AM) -> RN-2313
- Maya: file RN tickets and own overall follow-up cadence

Kevin Zhou: I'm on it. will post PR link and perf numbers when ready.

Sophia Kim: hotfix in progress, will ping when canary is up. :thumbsup:

Jonas Rivera: sample export done, path: /mnt/shared/incident-dumps/1799234567/sample_window.json. kicking off small backfill now.

Liam O'Connor: dashboard PR created: github.com/redwood/observability/pull/789. alert thresholds in the PR description.

Maya Patel: let's reconvene 24h check-in in #incidents tomorrow 09:30 and a deeper sync next Tue 10:00. thanks all. :heart:

Kevin Zhou: noted. daily check-ins on #eng-oncall as well.

ops-bot: reminder set for 'Incident: Observability aggregation follow-up' on 2026-03-24T09:30:00Z and recurring monthly audits.

Sophia Kim: thanks, closing loop on my side soon.

Jonas Rivera: backfill completed (sample). monitoring RT metrics for duplicates now. so far so good.

Maya Patel: closing this thread for now — I'll update RN tickets with timelines and put items in the sprint board. will reopen if any regressions.

Kevin Zhou: thanks everyone.
